title.orig: Plaque which Apollo 11 astronauts will leave on the moon (S69-39334)
title.zh: 阿波罗 11 号铭牌（复制品）

artist.en: NASA Manned Spacecraft Center (now Johnson Space Center)
artist.zh: NASA 载人航天器中心（今约翰逊航天中心）

medium.en: Photograph of a replica of the stainless-steel plaque (NASA S69-39334)
medium.zh: 不锈钢铭牌复制品的照片（NASA 编号 S69-39334）

basis.en: A NASA photograph, and so a US federal government work, which is not subject to copyright (17 U.S.C. § 105).
basis.zh: NASA 拍摄的照片，属于美国联邦政府作品，不受版权保护（《美国法典》第 17 编第 105 条）。

alt.en: A white plaque with two black hemispheres of Earth’s continents, four lines of capitals and four signatures below.
alt.zh: 一块白色铭牌：两个以黑色绘出大陆的地球半球，下面是四行大写字母和四个签名。

note.en: NASA’s pre-flight photograph of a replica, released in July 1969, in which every word can be read. The plaque itself measures nine by seven and five-eighths inches and is one-sixteenth of an inch thick.
note.zh: NASA 在飞行前发布的复制品照片（1969 年 7 月），上面每个字都清晰可读。铭牌原件长 9 英寸、宽 7⅝ 英寸，厚十六分之一英寸。
